description: Find Indian colleges and universities (including online and distance universities) on CareerBhavan. Filter by name, a course they offer, city, institution type, and total-fee budget in INR. Returns slugs, location, NAAC/NIRF, approvals and fees.

course.description: Only colleges offering this course, e.g. "Online MBA".
